description: Survivor 51 marks the beginning of the 'Open Era' for the series, featuring 21 new castaways divided into two tribes competing in Fiji under a game defined by total uncertainty and the return of iconic twists from past seasons.

season_name: Survivor: In the Hands of the Fans

description: Survivor: In the Hands of the Fans is the fiftieth season of the series, featuring a cast of 24 returning players and game mechanics determined by an online public vote to celebrate the show's twenty-fifth anniversary.
